subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding startup costs and calculating how much money is needed to begin a small business
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts and totals sample startup cost items (equipment, supplies, licensing) for a simple business idea
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a business type to the startup costs it would likely require
exercise.abstract: Student calculates total startup costs for a given simple business scenario

misconception_flags: omits a necessary startup cost category when calculating the total

interest_binding: business idea generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
